title: Training result (BE TrainingResultView)
description: Body of GET /api/training/sessions/{id}/result once the session is Completed (409 RESULT_NOT_READY before). The server computes it from the received events and the pinned rubric; Unity never scores. Mobile shows it (debrief) and may pass it to Unity unchanged.

outcome.description: Completion is not Passed; only Assessment is scored.

criteria.description: Assessment only; null for Learn and Guided.

metrics.description: Server metrics by name (reached_exit, completion_time_seconds, wrong_exits, hazard_exposure, distance_meters, step_count and route_efficiency (BE#216, present only when the runtime sent Moved.steps / RouteBaseline), optimal_distance_meters (the RouteBaseline, for the result card, not scorable), player-action counts declared by the session's runtime); see GET /api/scenario-rubrics/catalog?runtimeVersion=.

value.description: Metric value (number), or null when the metric was not computed.

passed.description: null when the criterion is not evaluable (reason METRIC_NOT_EVALUABLE): its weight is left out of the score and it never fails a mandatory requirement.

reason.description: METRIC_UNAVAILABLE: metric not computed, the criterion fails. METRIC_NOT_EVALUABLE (BE#216): a step_count or route_efficiency criterion without runtime telemetry.
